title: push-policy: accept the claim generation counter so task claims publish again
goal: Board item 120 (grok): every `susi tasks claim` failed because its single atomic push moves refs/claims/<id>, refs/claim-agents/<AGENT> and refs/claim-generation/current, and xtask/src/push_policy.rs refused refs/claim-generation/ as an unsupported namespace (the CLI then misreported a concurrent claim). refs/claim-generation/current is a blob like the other task metadata (checked on origin), so it joins the metadata-blob namespace with the same rule: create, replace and delete allowed, a non-blob refused, nothing built. Grok's repro now exits 0.
